title: The coefficient prime is a unit on a scheme over the base field
statement: Let k be a field and l a prime different from ringChar k. For every scheme Y equipped with a morphism Y->Spec(k), the integer l is a unit in Gamma(Y,O_Y). No finite-type or smoothness assumption is needed.

source.place: Opening condition l invertible on X, specialized to schemes over a field of characteristic different from l.

proof.text: CharP.cast_ne_zero_of_ne_of_prime makes l nonzero in k, hence a unit. Map this unit through the inverse of GammaSpecIso and the global-sections map of the structure morphism. Ring homomorphisms preserve units and natural-number casts.
